Crystal Clear Acrylic Shower Rod with Decorative Brackets, FII-DEC-1-59

Made in the USA by the master craftsmen at First Impressions from the finest crystal clear acrylic available. The acrylic is manufactured with UV inhibitors to prevent yellowing and fading. Set includes acrylic rod, decorative satin nickel mounting brackets and installation hardware.

Specifications for First Impressions FII-DEC-1-59 Clear Acrylic Shower Rod

  • Rod Diameter: 1"
  • Bracket Material: Solid Brass
  • Bracket Projection: 1-3/16"
  • Bracket Diameter: 1-11/16"
  • Rod Material: Clear Acrylic
  • Rod Length: 59"
  • Pull Bracket Material: Solid Brass
  • Bracket Finish: Satin Nickel

Note: This shower rod is made to order in the USA —allowing it to be custom sized to fit your specific needs, including Other Lengths and Finishes. Unfortunately, because it is custom cut and polished to your specifications, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

* Sold individually.
